messages:
emma (docs): Opened a docs PR to update SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries. Main checklist: update streaming examples to use async iterators, show language-idiomatic method names, add a retries/backoff snippet, and fix a broken internal link to the retry guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sarah (eng): on it — I'll review Python and TypeScript snippets. Quick Q: are we changing behaviour or just examples?

mike (sdk): I'll take Go. Also curious about naming convention: are we standardizing on streamGenerate across TS/Go and stream_generate for Python?

emma (docs): correct — keep idiomatic names per language. Python: stream_generate; TS/Go: streamGenerate. No runtime behaviour changes intended, just example updates.

ben (qa): can we add a tiny harness that runs the streaming snippet in CI (sanity-only)? async generator edges tend to slip.

emma (docs): added a minimal harness in the PR description that can be run locally. Also pasted the updated snippets below for quick review.

emma (docs): ```python
# python streaming + retry example
from redwood import Client
import asyncio

client = Client()

async def run():
    async for chunk in client.stream_generate("Summarize the following text...", max_tokens=256, retry_policy={"backoff":"exponential","max_retries":3}):
        print(chunk.text)

asyncio.run(run())
```

emma (docs): ```ts
// typescript streaming example
const stream = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: "Summarize the following text...", maxTokens: 256 });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  console.log(chunk.text);
}
```

emma (docs): ```go
// go pagination cursor + context cancellation example
ctx := context.Background()
req := &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{ PageSize: 50 }
iter := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, req)
for iter.Next() {
    item := iter.Item()
    // handle item
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
    // handle error / retry logic
}
```

olga (docs): small nit — TS snippet needs explicit `for await` line in the docs (I'll push a one-line fix). Also the link to the retry doc is currently pointing to `/retries` but the canonical path is `/retry-guides`.

mike (sdk): pushed a Go snippet tweak to show context cancellation and a short example of cursor-based pagination (cursor token example in comments).

deploy-bot: deploy check — docs preview build succeeded for PR #482 (netlify-preview/482) :white_check_mark:

sarah (eng): :eyes: will do a last pass. Ben, can you run the harness and sanity-check the async example?

emma (docs): thanks — I'll fix the link to /retry-guides and incorporate the TS caveat. Also added a short blurb under "Streaming caveats" about KV-cache interactions with streaming responses.
